club.intro_desc: The Just Dubai Club is designed to reward your loyalty from day one. From your very first booking, you automatically join a circle of excellence and unlock exclusive benefits across our entire fleet of cars and yachts. The more you book, the greater your privileges.
club.status_subtitle: Your status evolves naturally with your loyalty. No action required.
club.silver_desc: Welcome to the Club. From your very first rental, you unlock exclusive benefits reserved for our members.
club.gold_desc: Your loyalty is recognised. Enhanced benefits and exclusive discounts for a next-level experience.
club.platinum_desc: The pinnacle of the Just Dubai Club. Fully bespoke service, maximum discounts and unmatched privileges.
club.join_desc: The Just Dubai Club is automatic. Book your first car or yacht and join the Club immediately.

about.label: About
about.title: About us
about.subtitle: JustDubai, on the Dubai scene since 2021
about.para_1: Founded in 2021 by luxury automotive and maritime enthusiasts, JustDubai has established itself on the Dubai scene as the reference for high-end rentals. Present at the heart of Dubai from day one, we live and breathe this exceptional city.
about.para_2: Our team, built around complementary profiles, ensures every detail is perfect, from digital presence to operational management, from automotive expertise to yacht excellence.
about.team_ops_desc: Ensuring daily service excellence: delivery logistics, fleet management, client follow-up. Every booking is handled with precision and passion to guarantee a flawless experience.
about.team_social_desc: At the heart of Dubai's digital scene, our social media team captures the essence of luxury and shares it with the world. Content, trends, storytelling: we bring JustDubai to life online.
about.team_car_desc: A lifelong supercar enthusiast, he selects each vehicle in the fleet with exacting standards. His deep knowledge of the Dubai automotive market ensures an offering that always meets the highest expectations.
about.team_yacht_desc: A lover of the sea and fine vessels, he oversees the entire nautical fleet. From safety to the onboard experience, every detail is crafted to turn each sea trip into an extraordinary moment.
about.value_1_desc: A premium fleet selected for its prestige and reliability.
about.value_2_desc: A 24/7 service, attentive to your every request.
about.value_3_desc: Complete confidentiality on your bookings and personal data.
about.value_4_desc: No deposit options, immediate delivery, booking in just a few minutes.
